name: Bryan Biggers
office: William S. Hart Union High School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 2

items.text: Bryan Biggers is a small business owner. He co-founded Victory Builders, a construction company. He is an elder at Grace Baptist Church. He has a business degree from CSUN and has been a substitute teacher in the district.

sentences.text: Bryan Biggers is a small business owner.
He co-founded Victory Builders, a construction company.
He is an elder at Grace Baptist Church.

items.text: At a candidate forum, Biggers pointed to fiscal pressure from declining enrollment as the most pressing challenge, stating the board must operate with fiscal prudence and diligence. He said improving district communications is a priority to better engage and inform parents. His campaign says he wants to ensure district schools continue to deliver the highest levels of education, preparation and training.
